name: Secundus (from Thessalonica)
title: Paul's Traveling Companions from Thessalonica
summary: Secundus was a Christian from Thessalonica who traveled with the apostle Paul on his third missionary journey. He was part of the group that accompanied Paul from Greece through Macedonia and onward to Asia, likely as a representative of the church in Thessalonica in connection with the collection for the poor in Jerusalem.

keyEvents.title: Traveling Companions with Paul
keyEvents.description: Secundus is mentioned as one of the representatives from Thessalonica who accompanied Paul from Greece through Macedonia on his way to Jerusalem.

keyEvents.title: Part of the Collection Delegation
keyEvents.description: As a representative from Thessalonica, Secundus likely helped deliver the church's gift to the poor Christians in Jerusalem, an important task that strengthened fellowship between Gentile and Jewish Christian congregations.

keyEvents.title: The Journey from Philippi
keyEvents.description: After the Passover festival in Philippi, the group including Secundus continued on and met Paul and Luke at Troas.
